verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.smooth.sh that indexes Markdown versions of the docs pages, and the cited doc URLs are themselves served as .md. The docs also include agent-oriented CLI guides for Claude Code, OpenClaw and other agents. One community commenter notes the docs pages aren't very token-efficient, which is a minor caveat rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or consolidated single-file agent context, docs token-efficiency questioned by a user.
